title: Jenesis House Wellness Retreat
name: Jenesis House Retreat
p1: Four days in Sedona’s red rock country, made for rest. Mornings begin with yoga or Pilates, afternoons bring a massage and a facial, and evenings settle into a floating sound bath and a fireside Let It Go ceremony.
p2: Your accommodations, nourishing meals and local transportation are all arranged. This is a land-only retreat: bring yourself, and leave the planning to us.
storyImg: Cathedral Rock glowing at golden hour
presImg: A guest relaxing in an infinity pool
presText: Every day includes nourishing meals and snacks and a morning movement class. Your stay includes a 60-minute massage, a 60-minute facial, and an optional hike at your own pace through the red rocks.
